legal_ref: Value Added Tax Act 1994 s.2(1), as amended by Finance (No. 2) Act 2010 s.3
quote: VAT shall be charged at the rate of 20 per cent — VATA 1994 s.2(1). F(No.2)A 2010 s.3(3): "The amendment made by subsection (1) has effect in relation to any supply made on or after 4 January 2011"
source_title: legislation.gov.uk — Value Added Tax Act 1994, section 2; Finance (No. 2) Act 2010 section 3 (https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2010/31/section/3)

reduced_rates.scope: domestic fuel and power, children's car seats, smoking cessation products, mobility aids for the elderly, certain residential conversions/renovations (VATA 1994 Sch. 7A)
most food, children's clothes, books/newspapers, passenger transport, exports (VATA 1994 Sch. 8)

notes: HMRC (gov.uk/vat-rates): standard 20%, reduced 5%, zero 0%; exemptions e.g. postage stamps, financial and property transactions. Registration threshold: taxable turnover over £90,000 in the last 12 months (gov.uk/vat-registration/when-to-register). Northern Ireland follows EU VAT rules for goods under the Windsor Framework.
